mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 70% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPIAUCSL is above 3% YoY, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative policy and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% over 3 months
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS is consistently above its 12-month moving average and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% during a late-cycle expansion and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis fails.
